text: make yourselves strange to me: Or, harden yourselves against me
mine own body: Heb. my belly
my inward friends: Heb. the men of my secret
Oh that my words were now written: Heb. who will give? etc.
And though after my skin worms destroy this body, yet in my flesh shall I see God: Or, After I shall awake though this body be destroyed, yet out of my flesh shall I see God
another: Heb. a stranger | within me: Heb. in my bosom
seeing the root of the matter is found in me: Or, and what root of matter is found in me?
